lines.text: Job asks how long his friends will crush him with their words, and says they have reproached him ten times.
Job says God has drawn His net around him, blocked his way, and removed the helmet from his head.
Job says God's troops advance together, build a ramp against him, and camp around his tent.
Job's servant does not answer his call, and his wife finds his breath repulsive, while even little boys scorn him.
Job wants his words chiseled in stone forever, knows his Redeemer lives, and warns his friends to fear the plague.
